newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Bonino faints after all-night fish marathon.
newsitem.headline: EU's Bonino faints after all-night fish marathon.

text.p: Italian European Commissioner Emma Bonino collapsed after battling for 21 hours to protect endangered fish stocks from the demands of EU ministers trying to keep their fishermen happy.
"Bonino fought to the end, gave a final speech and fainted," her spokesman Filippo di Robilant said.
"The Commissioner was exhausted after two years of strenuous work without holidays. It finally caught up with her," he added.

The Italian commissioner, who also handles EU humanitarian aid, spends her spare time visiting the front line, coming under fire in Somalia at Easter and confronting angry British fishermen in the autumn.

The 48-year-old Bonino, who accused Canada of piracy during the so-called turbot war in 1995, showed her support for Spanish trawlermen in the north west Atlantic by being lowered onto deck from a helicopter.
Di Robilant criticised the EU's "macho" tradition of annual all-night bargaining on fish quotas to hammer out a compromise at dawn, saying he was unsure if this produced the best decision.
"It's masochistic for commissioners and ministers and sadistic for journalists," he said, adding that Bonino was at home recuperating.
